home.ctaText: Place your order in minutes and confirm it on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: How do I place an order?
faqs.a: Add products to your cart, enter your delivery details and tap 'Confirm Order on WhatsApp'. Your order is saved first, then WhatsApp opens with your order message. Please press Send.

faqs.q: Do I need to pay online?
faqs.a: No. There is no online payment on this website. We confirm your order on WhatsApp and agree the payment method with you (for example Cash on Delivery or UPI).
It depends on your location. We will share an estimate when we confirm your order on WhatsApp.

faqs.q: How can I track my order?
faqs.a: Open 'Track Order' and enter your Order ID and mobile number.

faqs.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
faqs.a: Yes, before it is shipped. Please message us on WhatsApp with your Order ID.
